notes: The DAAD page is a database entry, not the university's own programme page; the programme's own website is https://www.hs-kl.de/iba-en. The application deadline 31 May is valid for applicants from all countries (including non-EU). The application period section on the page also contains a copyright year '©' and the page context 'International Programmes 2026/2027', so 31 May is presumed to be 2027-05-31; the quote itself does not state a year, so the year is inferred. Application channel: the page says to submit via uni-assist and website, but does not mention a VPD (preliminary review), so de-uni-assist is used. Tuition: the quote says 'Tuition fees per semester None', but the programme page does not specify that this applies to non-EU applicants; it is recorded as stated. The page also states a semester contribution of 139 EUR, not a tuition fee.
